record.paper_title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures: Open Questions and Perspectives
record.original_question: Is there a thickness limit of the antiferromagnetic layer below which or above which exchange bias can no longer be induced in ferromagnet/antiferromagnet van der Waals systems?

evidence.quote: v. Is there a thickness limit of the AFM layer for inducing the EB effect in FM/AFM vdW systems?

artifact.category_tag: van der Waals magnetic heterostructures / exchange bias
artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider a heterostructure formed by stacking a two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnetic (FM) layer on a two-dimensional van der Waals antiferromagnetic (AFM) layer. After field-cooling the system through the Néel temperature of the AFM in an applied magnetic field, the hysteresis loop of the FM layer can be shifted along the field axis; this shift is the exchange bias (EB) effect, attributed to interfacial exchange coupling between the pinned uncompensated AFM moments and the FM layer.\n\nLet t denote the thickness of the AFM layer (measured in number of monolayers or in nanometers). Determine whether there exist critical thickness values t_min and/or t_max such that the exchange bias field H_EB(t) is strictly zero for t < t_min or for t > t_max, while H_EB(t) ≠ 0 for thicknesses in between. Equivalently: characterize the dependence of the induced exchange bias on the AFM layer thickness in FM/AFM van der Waals heterostructures, and identify any lower or upper thickness limits beyond which exchange bias cannot be induced.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as one of several open problems concerning exchange bias in two-dimensional van der Waals magnetic heterostructures. Experimental studies on systems such as Fe3GeTe2/FePS3, CrCl3/CrSBr, and similar vdW FM/AFM stacks report thickness-dependent EB behavior, but no consensus universal lower or upper AFM-thickness limit has been established; the question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures
status_evidence.snippet: Lists as an open question whether there is a thickness limit of the AFM layer for inducing the EB effect in FM/AFM vdW systems.
status_evidence.claim: The AFM thickness limit for inducing exchange bias in vdW FM/AFM heterostructures is identified as an unresolved open question.
